ignore — hide a kind of line, for you alone (.mute hides a person)

  .ignore                 list them all
  .ignore <cat> yes|no    hide it / show it
  .ignore <cat> default   back to the default (which is: shown)
  .ignore default         show every category again

login_msg     logging in — jailed arrivals included
logout_msg    logging out
enter_msg     someone walking into your room
exit_msg      someone walking out of your room
afk_msg       someone going AFK in your room
shout         shouts from elsewhere
atmospherics  the room's own murmurs
tab_alert     the browser tab mark when you're away (web door only)

Every category starts shown, and 'default' always means shown — unlike
.set, nothing here follows a house setting. Some names match .set
topics; that is a coincidence of naming, not a shared value.

What you ignore is also left out of .rev — it replays the room as you
would have seen it live, not as everyone else did.

Two things show whatever you set: staff entering a locked room, and the
AFK notice on a tell you just sent.
